notes.title: v1.1.0
notes.content:
[h3]Additions:[/h3]
- Selection of bot colors for player 1 and player 2/computer from the "Arcade" menu.
- Two new special orb mechanics (growth and confusion).

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
- AI counter balancing regarding mega-smashes.
- Missing preview video in the guide.
- Various minor fixes.
